name: Jalali Set

members.name: Shafayat
members.role: Rapper (joined 2014; formerly of RHG / Green Coast)

members.name: Shadhu
members.role: Member (previously active in the underground scene)

global_influences.evidence: Jalali Set's sound is described as a fusion of hip-hop, trap and electronic music, reflecting direct absorption of contemporary American trap production techniques into the group's Level 13 (2016) material.
global_influences.source: Various music-scene profiles; halftimeonline.net Bangladesh hip-hop overview

local_adaptation_notes: Formed when MC Mugz (from the pioneering Deshi MCs crew) and Shafayat (from RHG/Green Coast) joined forces in 2014, Jalali Set built its identity on raw Dhaka street slang and socially conscious lyrics addressing politics, society and individual hardship; the 2022 single 'Bhober Pagol' explicitly fused hip-hop/trap with traditional Bangladeshi folk instrumentation (dotara, ektara), directly paralleling the folk-fusion adaptation strategies seen in Arnob's and Habib Wahid's work but applied within a hip-hop framework.
sound_evolution_summary: Formative period (2014): coalesced from members of established underground crews (Deshi MCs, RHG/Green Coast) plus Shadhu, an established underground-scene figure. Breakthrough period (2015–2016): viral single 'Sura Target' (2015) preceded debut album Level 13 (2016), recognized for its raw local sound and Dhaka slang. Later period (2022): 'Bhober Pagol' extended the group's palette into folk-hip-hop fusion using traditional instruments, broadening the group's sonic and thematic range beyond straight trap/hip-hop.
concert_culture_notes: Emerged from Dhaka's underground hip-hop crew scene (Deshi MCs, RHG/Green Coast lineage) rather than a mainstream media pipeline, consistent with the DIY, crew-based development pattern common to early 2010s Bangladeshi hip-hop before the genre's later mainstream/viral breakthroughs.
listener_community_notes: A key node in the Bangladeshi hip-hop ecosystem alongside Stoic Bliss, Muza and Hannan, notable for bridging underground/socially-conscious hip-hop audiences with folk-music listener communities via tracks like 'Bhober Pagol.'
